market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. 10Y above 5%, oil surge, and rate-hike bets create headwinds. September seasonality historically weak. Consumer stress and retail bankruptcies signal demand softening. AI safety debate may cause brief tech volatility but markets currently shrugging it off. Expect choppy, range-bound action with downside risk if oil continues climbing.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure monetization (Nvidia, Anthropic) validates secular trend. India and EM market reforms create structural capital inflows. Canada positioning as investment hub. However, sustained 5%+ yields and inflation risk cap multiple expansion. Favor quality, dividend, and income-generating assets over speculative growth.
